messages:
Ava: Heads-up: Console alerted about a new spike of 413s on /v1/embeddings around 10:04 UTC, looks different from prior dim-mismatch ones.
Diego: I pulled a sample trace, payloads are gzipped ndarrays from a partner and they do NOT set X-Units. Router tries quick unit-check and throws 413 before body inspection.
Priya: Is router explicitly refusing gzipped bodies? We only wanted to fast-fail truly oversized headers.
Diego: Code currently trusts X-Units when present, otherwise calls estimate_from_json(body). estimate_from_json expects utf-8 JSON and raises on binary/gzip -> bubbled up as 413.
Ava: Two immediate asks: (1) fix router to catch parsing errors and route to slowpath, (2) surface unit attribution in telemetry so we can tell header vs estimate vs parse-fail.
Marta: ops-bot created alert -> embedding_413_unattributed > 0.2% for 10m.
Priya: Agreed on catching parse errors. Alternative is to gzip-detect and always slowpath gzipped requests without X-Units. Which is cheaper perf-wise?
Diego: Slower, but safer. Slowpath will decompress & estimate; better than exploding. We should also make the router emit units_source tag: header|gzip_unknown|estimated|unknown_error.
Ava: Add console breakdown and expose a per-tenant row so CS can follow up with partners.
Priya: Will do panic-minimal patch: try: estimate_from_json() except UnicodeDecodeError, JSONDecodeError -> set units_source=gzip_unknown; route slowpath; emit metric. Add unit test that gzipped array does not produce 413.
Diego: Also adding a guard: if X-Units present but obviously wrong (e.g., negative or huge), we should still validate and maybe recalc. Too many clients trust naive libs.
Marta: ops-bot: recording deployment window request for canary at 10:40 UTC.
Ava: For longer term: ask SDK teams to set X-Units when sending compressed bodies and include an example in our client libs. Also update API docs to say X-Units required for non-JSON content types.
Priya: I'll open two PRs: one small router fix + tests, one console telemetry change (add units_source, tenant tag).
Diego: Can we add a temporary console card that highlights gzipped requests with unknown units? That will help narrow top offenders.
Marta: ops-bot: canary deploy started embedding-router v2.4.0-canary -> infra-canary-eu-west-1.
Priya: Canary logs show 413 rate for that cohort down ~88%. Console now reports units_source breakdown. I flagged top 5 tenants with gzip_unknown and sent the list to CS.
Ava: Nice. Follow-up: schedule a short SDK sync, and plan a migration notice for partners to add X-Units. We'll keep the slowpath fallback for 30 days then revisit.
Diego: PRs: #8567 (router error-handling + tests), #8568 (telemetry + console card). PTAL.
Ava: Thanks team — monitor for 1h and we'll promote if stable. :thumbsup:
